<!-- Please search existing issues before submitting a new suggestion. -->

## What would you like to improve?

Describe the need, inconvenience, or missing feature.

## Your suggestion

Explain how you would like StoryArk to work.
A specific writing scenario or example is helpful.

## Why would this help?

Describe how this would improve your writing or planning workflow.

## Alternatives (optional)

Have you tried a workaround or considered another approach?

## Examples or screenshots (optional)

Add sketches, screenshots, or links that help explain your idea.
Remove private writing and other sensitive information before sharing.
